questions.question: The average age of 38 students of a class is 21 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 22 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age of new person = New Average + (Previous members × Increase in average)

Age of Teacher = 22 + (38 × (22 − 21))

Age of Teacher = 22 + (38 × 1)

Age of Teacher = 22 + 38 = 60 years

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial students = 38, Initial Average = 21 years

New Average (including teacher) = 22 years

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total Sum of values ÷ Number of values

Total Sum = Average × Number of values

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c416d1357bafc2212bc1c950c2b9a878799b46c00703167a5afa706de24ea911.png] 

⇒ Total age of 38 students = 38 × 21 = 798 years

⇒ Total number of people including teacher = 38 + 1 = 39

⇒ Total age of 39 people = 39 × 22 = 858 years

⇒ Age of the teacher = (Total age of 39 people) − (Total age of 38 students)

⇒ Age of the teacher = 858 − 798 = 60 years

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When two groups are combined, the combined average is (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Net Deviation

The sum of deviations of all observations from the average is always zero.

Average Inclusion Rule

If the new value is greater than the original average, the overall average increases; if smaller, it decreases.

questions.question: During a New-Year sale, a company gives a ‘Buy 9 Sweaters and Get 1 Free’ offer to customers. The percentage discount involved in this deal is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In 'Buy X Get Y Free' offers, the discount is calculated on the total number of items.

Total Items = Paid Items + Free Items = 9 + 1 = 10

Discount % = (Free Items ÷ Total Items) × 100

Discount % = (1 ÷ 10) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Buy = 9 sweaters, Free = 1 sweater.

Formula: Discount % = [Free Items ÷ (Buy Items + Free Items)] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b62d4a16409d2d9cfbdfb6c628c11b58ac9bea12370ff2ba692bfd6343ce7c28.png] 

Let the Marked Price (MP) of each sweater be ₹1.

⇒ Total MP for 10 sweaters = 10 × 1 = ₹10

⇒ Customer pays for only 9 sweaters.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) for 10 sweaters = 9 × 1 = ₹9

⇒ Discount Amount = MP − SP = 10 − 9 = ₹1

⇒ Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100

⇒ Discount % = (1 ÷ 10) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When two discounts d₁ and d₂ are applied, effective discount = d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂) ÷ 100.

Markup Percentage

Markup % is the percentage by which MP is higher than CP: [(MP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100.

Profit and Discount Relationship

The ratio of MP to CP is given by: MP/CP = (100 + Profit%) ÷ (100 − Discount%).

questions.question: Two banks, A and B, offered loans at 3.5% and 7.5% per annum, respectively. Manjit borrowed an amount of ₹2,20,000 from each bank. Find the positive difference (in ₹) between the amounts of simple interest paid to the two banks by Manjit after 2 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in Annual Rates = 7.5% − 3.5% = 4%

Difference in interest for 2 years = 4% × 2 = 8%

Required difference = 8% of ₹2,20,000

Difference = 0.08 × 2,20,000 = ₹17,600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹17,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Principal (P) = ₹2,20,000

Rate of Bank A (R₁) = 3.5% | Rate of Bank B (R₂) = 7.5%

Time (T) = 2 years

Formula: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02eb92b196e8a5c89fce46e20155bef9e4197fea1702adeec80dbaada49260b9.png] 

⇒ SI from Bank A = (2,20,000 × 3.5 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ SIA = 2,200 × 7 = ₹15,400

⇒ SI from Bank B = (2,20,000 × 7.5 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ SIB = 2,200 × 15 = ₹33,000

⇒ Difference = SIB − SIA = 33,000 − 15,400

⇒ Difference = ₹17,600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹17,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI) Difference Formula

When Principal (P) and Time (T) are constant, the difference in interest is: ΔSI = (P × ΔR × T) ÷ 100, where ΔR is the difference in interest rates.

SI vs CI for First Year

For the first year, if the interest is compounded annually, the Simple Interest and Compound Interest on the same principal and rate are always equal.

SI and CI Difference for 2 Years

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years is given by: CI − SI = P(R ÷ 100)².

questions.question: The income of Raman is ₹49,000. He saves 27.5% of his income. If his income increases by 34% and expenditure increases by 20%, then his savings will:4744
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income = 100%, Savings = 27.5%, Expenditure = 72.5%.

ΔSavings = ΔIncome − ΔExpenditure

ΔIncome = 34% of 100 = 34 units

ΔExpenditure = 20% of 72.5 = 14.5 units

ΔSavings = 34 − 14.5 = 19.5 units

Actual Increase = 19.5% of 49,000 = 19.5 × 490 = ₹9,555.

**∴ The correct answer is increase by ₹9,555.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Income = ₹49,000 | Savings % = 27.5% | Income Increase = 34% | Expenditure Increase = 20%

Formula: Income = Expenditure + Savings

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f3ec5cc57559950a88b020e3a9578ee3546f9ab3fa425cbec9cc81940ff8230.png] 

⇒ Initial Savings = 27.5% of 49,000

⇒ Initial Savings = (27.5 ÷ 100) × 49,000 = 13,475

⇒ Initial Expenditure = 49,000 − 13,475 = 35,525

⇒ Increase in Income = 34% of 49,000 = 0.34 × 49,000 = 16,660

⇒ Increase in Expenditure = 20% of 35,525 = 0.20 × 35,525 = 7,105

⇒ Increase in Savings = Increase in Income − Increase in Expenditure

⇒ Increase in Savings = 16,660 − 7,105 = 9,555

**∴ The correct answer is increase by ₹9,555.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Identity

Income is always the sum of Expenditure and Savings (I = E + S). Any change in Income must be balanced by the sum of changes in Expenditure and Savings.

Percentage Change in Components

If Income increases by x% and Expenditure increases by y%, the percentage change in Savings is given by (I×x − E×y)/S.

Effective Savings Ratio

When the income is very large, using ratios of savings to expenditure (e.g., 27.5 : 72.5 → 11 : 29) simplifies calculations significantly.

questions.question: If 20% of 90% of 5over9 of a number is 345. Find the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentages and fractions into a single multiplier.

20% × 90% × 5/9 ⇒ (1/5) × (9/10) × (5/9)

Multiplying the terms: (1 × 9 × 5) / (5 × 10 × 9) = 1/10

If 1/10 of the number is 345, then the total number is 345 × 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 3450.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Result = 345

Percentages = 20% and 90%

Fraction = 5/9

**Formula Used:**

Value = Number × (P₁/100) × (P₂/100) × Fraction

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3fed50550ba7fa1119546b1c37d893b891bcbb3b70475c9e83c56062fa84107.png] 

Let the number be x.

⇒ x × (5/9) × (90/100) × (20/100) = 345

⇒ x × (5/9) × (9/10) × (1/5) = 345

⇒ x × (5 × 9 × 1) / (9 × 10 × 5) = 345

⇒ x × (1/10) = 345

⇒ x = 345 × 10

⇒ x = 3450

**∴ The correct answer is 3450.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To simplify calculations, convert common percentages: 20% = 1/5, 25% = 1/4, 50% = 1/2, and 10% = 1/10.

Successive Percentage Application

When multiple percentages are applied to a single base, the net multiplier is the product of individual fraction equivalents: Net % = (P₁ × P₂ × ... × Pₙ).

Reverse Percentage Calculation

If the final value is given and the original is required, multiply the final value by the inverse of each multiplier: Original = Final × (1/M₁) × (1/M₂).

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 77 cm, 36 cm and 85 cm. What is the length of its altitude corresponding to the side with the length of 36 cm?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check for Pythagorean triplet: 36² + 77² = 1296 + 5929 = 7225 = 85².

Since it is a right-angled triangle, the side perpendicular to the base is the altitude.

For base = 36 cm, the corresponding altitude = 77 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 77 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given sides of triangle: a = 77 cm, b = 36 cm, c = 85 cm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed5c1d93e5e452982c51bcfb2414286b2d9b3cde5583b0ff52ef7b6edfc99ff1.png] 

First, verify if the triangle is right-angled using Pythagoras Theorem:

⇒ 36² + 77² = 1296 + 5929 = 7225

⇒ 85² = 7225

⇒ Since 36² + 77² = 85², the triangle is right-angled with hypotenuse 85 cm.

⇒ Area of triangle = (1/2) × base × height

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 36 × 77

⇒ For any base, Area = (1/2) × base × corresponding altitude

⇒ (1/2) × 36 × altitude = (1/2) × 36 × 77

⇒ altitude = 77 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 77 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplets

A set of three positive integers a, b, and c, such that a² + b² = c². Common examples include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (36, 77, 85).

Heron's Formula

For a triangle with sides a, b, and c, Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)], where semi-perimeter s = (a + b + c) / 2.

Altitude of a Triangle

The perpendicular segment from a vertex to the opposite side. In a right-angled triangle, the legs are altitudes to each other.

questions.question: ₹567 is divided among Arjun, Nisha and Gaurav in such a way that if ₹10, ₹45 and ₹39 are deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 3:6:2. Find the actual share of Nisha.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total deduction = 10 + 45 + 39 = ₹94

Adjusted total amount = 567 − 94 = ₹473

Total ratio units = 3 + 6 + 2 = 11

11 units = ₹473 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹43

Nisha’s actual share = (6 × 43) + 45 = 258 + 45 = ₹303

**∴ The correct answer is ₹303.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total sum = ₹567, Deductions from Arjun, Nisha, and Gaurav are ₹10, ₹45, and ₹39 respectively. Ratio after deduction = 3 : 6 : 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01e5eca5f8b90987aa07be1a2bf3d91ca1baf39c0c7b76f6ea347aa994b4be56.png] 

⇒ Let the reduced shares be 3x, 6x, and 2x.

⇒ Total reduced sum = 3x + 6x + 2x = 11x

⇒ 11x = 567 − (10 + 45 + 39)

⇒ 11x = 473

⇒ x = 473 ÷ 11 = 43

⇒ Nisha’s reduced share = 6x = 6 × 43 = ₹258

⇒ Nisha’s actual share = 258 + 45 = ₹303

**∴ The correct answer is ₹303.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Distribution Rule

If an amount A is divided among P and Q in the ratio m:n, then share of P = [m ÷ (m+n)] × A.

Effective Sum adjustment

When values are subtracted or added to individual shares, the total sum must be adjusted by the net change before applying the ratio units.

Duplicate and Sub-duplicate Ratio

Duplicate ratio of a:b is a²:b² and sub-duplicate ratio is √a:√b.

questions.question: An article is sold at a gain of 30%. Had it been sold for ₹48 more, the profit would have been 35%. The cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in profit percentages = 35% − 30% = 5%

This 5% difference in profit is due to the ₹48 increase in selling price.

5% of Cost Price = ₹48

100% of Cost Price = (48 ÷ 5) × 100 = 9.6 × 100 = ₹960

**∴ The correct answer is ₹960.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial profit = 30%

New profit = 35%

Increase in Selling Price (SP) = ₹48

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3dcf586a5b9782f06c64b0ef0f9721445613ed4a18f324e760239162f716883.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Cost Price (CP) of the article be x.

⇒ Initial Selling Price (SP₁) = 1.30x

⇒ New Selling Price (SP₂) = 1.35x

⇒ According to the question, SP₂ − SP₁ = 48

⇒ 1.35x − 1.30x = 48

⇒ 0.05x = 48

⇒ x = 48 ÷ 0.05

⇒ x = 4800 ÷ 5

⇒ x = 960

**∴ The correct answer is ₹960.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Formulas

Profit = SP − CP and Loss = CP − SP. Profit% or Loss% is always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise.

Marked Price and Discount

Marked Price (MP) is the price listed on the product. Discount = MP − SP. Discount% = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Successive Percentage Change

If there are two successive profit percentages a% and b%, the effective profit percentage is given by [a + b + (a × b)/100]%.

questions.question: {If } x² + (1)/(x²) = 123, { then a possible value of } (x - (1)/(x)) { is:}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x² + 1/x² = k, then (x − 1/x) = √(k − 2).

Here, k = 123.

∴ (x − 1/x) = √(123 − 2) = √121 = 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: x² + 1/x² = 123

Formula used: (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

⇒ Let a = x and b = 1/x

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = x² + (1/x)² − 2 × x × (1/x)

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² − 2

⇒ Substitute the given value of x² + 1/x²:

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 123 − 2

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 121

⇒ x − 1/x = ±√121

⇒ x − 1/x = 11 (taking the positive value from options)

**∴ The correct answer is 11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identity

If x² + 1/x² = k, then (x + 1/x) = √(k + 2).

Cubic Relation

If (x − 1/x) = a, then the value of x³ − 1/x³ = a³ + 3a.

Fourth Power Relation

If x + 1/x = a, then x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (a² − 2)² − 2.

questions.question: Walking at 2/3rd of his normal speed, Abhijeet is 18 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio (Usual : New) = 1 : 2/3 = 3 : 2.

Since distance is constant, Time ratio = 2 : 3.

Difference in time units = 3 − 2 = 1 unit.

Given, 1 unit = 18 minutes.

Usual time = 2 units = 2 × 18 = 36 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f818f0e9e11e255bca532c0f973db7f73069292b6c8491757717a1387523a40d.png] 

Given: New Speed = 2/3 × Usual Speed | Late time = 18 minutes

Formula: Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Let usual speed = S and usual time = T.

⇒ Distance (D) = S × T

⇒ New speed = (2/3)S and New time = (T + 18)

⇒ D = (2/3)S × (T + 18)

⇒ S × T = (2/3)S × (T + 18)

⇒ T = (2/3)(T + 18)

⇒ 3T = 2T + 36

⇒ T = 36 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 36 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportionality of Speed and Time

When the distance is constant, speed (S) is inversely proportional to time (T). If speed becomes x/y of original, time becomes y/x of original.

Average Speed Formula

If an equal distance is covered at two different speeds x and y, the average speed for the whole journey is (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Time Delay Concept

If a person is late by t₁ and early by t₂ in two different scenarios, the total time difference used for calculations is (t₁ + t₂).

questions.question: (1)/(20) { is what percentage of } (2)/(40)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify the comparison: 2/40 reduces to 1/20.

Comparing 1/20 to 1/20 is a 1 : 1 ratio.

Any value compared to itself is 100%.

**∴ The correct answer is 100%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given values: Fraction A = 1/20 and Fraction B = 2/40

Formula: Percentage = (Fraction A ÷ Fraction B) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41f772de6189c0a26a60ae50280dfe82b2ef2b2866c57745966c919b3533c019.png] 

⇒ First Fraction = 1/20

⇒ Second Fraction = 2/40 = 1/20 (after dividing numerator and denominator by 2)

⇒ Required % = [(1/20) ÷ (1/20)] × 100

⇒ Required % = 1 × 100

⇒ Required % = 100%

**∴ The correct answer is 100%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage of a Value

To find what percentage x is of y, use the expression: (x ÷ y) × 100.

Equivalent Fractions

Fractions that look different but have the same value are equivalent; e.g., 1/2 = 2/4 = 50/100.

Decimal Conversion

1/20 can be written as 0.05. Therefore, 0.05 is (0.05 ÷ 0.05) × 100 = 100% of itself.

questions.question: {The HCF of } (1)/(2), (3)/(4), (27)/(16) { and } (81)/(64) { is:}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Formula: HCF of fractions = HCF(Numerators) ÷ LCM(Denominators)

Numerators are 1, 3, 27, 81 → HCF is 1

Denominators are 2, 4, 16, 64 → LCM is 64 (since 2, 4, 16 are factors of 64)

HCF = 1/64

**∴ The correct answer is 1/64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Fractions are 1/2, 3/4, 27/16, and 81/64.

Formula Used: HCF of (a/b, c/d, e/f) = HCF(a, c, e) / LCM(b, d, f)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2eeb005499d7b8a50cbfb19c2c3a304c34a76bd9a320b7e04c036daf790f1c5.png] 

⇒ Step 1: Find HCF of numerators {1, 3, 27, 81}

⇒ Factors of 1 = 1

⇒ Factors of 3 = 1, 3

⇒ Factors of 27 = 1, 3, 9, 27

⇒ Factors of 81 = 1, 3, 9, 27, 81

⇒ Common factor is 1 ∴ HCF = 1

⇒ Step 2: Find LCM of denominators {2, 4, 16, 64}

⇒ 2 = 2¹ | 4 = 2² | 16 = 2⁴ | 64 = 2⁶

⇒ LCM = 2⁶ = 64

⇒ Required HCF = 1/64

**∴ The correct answer is 1/64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM of Fractions

The LCM of fractions is calculated as: LCM of Fractions = LCM(Numerators) ÷ HCF(Denominators).

Simplification Rule

Always simplify fractions to their simplest form (coprime numerators and denominators) before calculating HCF or LCM.

HCF × LCM Property

For any two numbers A and B, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: A × B = HCF(A,B) × LCM(A,B).

HCF of Co-prime Numbers

If a set of numbers includes the number 1 or any two numbers that are co-prime, the HCF of the entire set is always 1.

questions.question: If 9 is subtracted from the numerator of a fraction, it becomes (2)/(9) , and if 12 is added to the denominator of the fraction, it becomes (1)/(3) . What is the sum of the numerator and the denominator of the original fraction?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the original fraction be x/y.

According to the conditions: 9(x − 9) = 2y and 3x = y + 12.

From the second eq, y = 3x − 12. Substitute this in the first eq.

9x − 81 = 2(3x − 12) ⇒ 9x − 81 = 6x − 24 ⇒ 3x = 57 ⇒ x = 19.

Then, y = 3(19) − 12 = 45. Sum = 19 + 45 = 64.

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Let the fraction be x/y.

Condition 1: (x − 9)/y = 2/9

Condition 2: x/(y + 12) = 1/3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c8aa37d2284f817e6b376ea8b9185231aa1bab1a30b1369c602a3c1145dffd7.png] 

From Condition 1:

⇒ 9(x − 9) = 2y

⇒ 9x − 81 = 2y → (Eq. 1)

From Condition 2:

⇒ 3x = y + 12

⇒ y = 3x − 12 → (Eq. 2)

Substitute y from (Eq. 2) into (Eq. 1):

⇒ 9x − 81 = 2(3x − 12)

⇒ 9x − 81 = 6x − 24

⇒ 3x = 57

⇒ x = 19

Substitute x = 19 in (Eq. 2):

⇒ y = 3(19) − 12 = 45

Sum of numerator and denominator:

⇒ x + y = 19 + 45 = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proper and Improper Fractions

A proper fraction has a numerator less than the denominator (e.g., 2/9), while an improper fraction has a numerator greater than or equal to the denominator.

Equivalent Fractions

Fractions that represent the same value even though they look different, obtained by multiplying or dividing both N and D by the same non-zero number.

Simplification of Fractions

Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing both the numerator and denominator by their Highest Common Factor (HCF).

questions.question: The age of a mother is three times the age of her daughter. After 12 years, the mother's age will be twice the daughter's age. Find the present age of the mother.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present Ratio (Mother : Daughter) = 3 : 1 (Difference = 2 units)

Ratio after 12 years = 2 : 1 (Difference = 1 unit)

Equate differences: Multiply future ratio by 2 → 4 : 2

Ratio change: 3 to 4 (Mother) or 1 to 2 (Daughter) = 1 unit

1 unit = 12 years

Mother's present age = 3 units = 3 × 12 = 36 years

**∴ The correct answer is 36 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mother's age = 3 × Daughter's age

After 12 years, Mother's age = 2 × Daughter's age

**Formula Used:**

Linear equations in one variable: Age after n years = Present Age + n

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/937cbaf4dca84de5308ece6157425c9ed717dc68c379d6b1ede6e9c95821ab9f.png] 

Let the present age of the daughter be x years.

⇒ Mother's present age = 3x

⇒ After 12 years, Mother's age = 3x + 12

⇒ After 12 years, Daughter's age = x + 12

⇒ 3x + 12 = 2 × (x + 12)

⇒ 3x + 12 = 2x + 24

⇒ 3x − 2x = 24 − 12

⇒ x = 12

⇒ Mother's present age = 3 × 12 = 36 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two individuals remains constant regardless of the number of years that pass.

Ratio Balancing Method

When ages at two different times are given as ratios, scaling the ratios to have the same part-difference allows for solving without algebra.

Average Age Property

If the current average age of a group is A, then after 'n' years, the new average age will be A + n.

questions.question: The ratio of the two sides of a rectangle is 2 : 3. If the area of the rectangle is 2646 cm², then its perimeter is ______ cm.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of sides = 2 : 3 ⇒ Area parts = 2 × 3 = 6

6 units² = 2646 ⇒ 1 unit² = 441

1 unit = √441 = 21 cm

Perimeter units = 2 × (2 + 3) = 10 units

Perimeter = 10 × 21 = 210

**∴ The correct answer is 210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of sides = 2 : 3

Area of rectangle = 2646 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area = Length × Breadth

Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62d1af82bf2e90bf7cd125b69ccd79ef186dafd664444ac1015a81b8850945b5.png] 

Let the sides of the rectangle be 2x and 3x.

⇒ Area = 2x × 3x

⇒ 2646 = 6x²

⇒ x² = 2646 ÷ 6

⇒ x² = 441

⇒ x = √441 = 21 cm

⇒ Length = 3 × 21 = 63 cm

⇒ Breadth = 2 × 21 = 42 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (63 + 42)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × 105 = 210 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rectangle Dimensions

The area of a rectangle is the product of its adjacent sides (Length × Breadth), while the perimeter is the sum of all its boundary sides.

Diagonal Property

The diagonal of a rectangle forms a right-angled triangle with the sides; hence, Diagonal = √(Length² + Breadth²).

Ratio and Area

If the sides are in the ratio a : b, the area is proportional to a × b × x², where x is the common multiplier.

questions.question: A class of 78 students took a Physics test. 17 students had an average score of 70. The remaining students had an average score of 90. What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assumed Average = 90

Deviation for 17 students = 17 × (70 − 90) = −340

Net change in average for 78 students = −340 ÷ 78 ≈ −4.36

Correct average = 90 − 4.36 = 85.64...

**∴ The correct answer is 85.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of students = 78

Number of students in first group (n₁) = 17, Average score (A₁) = 70

Number of students in second group (n₂) = 78 − 17 = 61, Average score (A₂) = 90

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/386243c140c1c2eaf99be034b3b5519cf918e61761ff431f17368a773d51c600.png] 

⇒ Total score of first group = 17 × 70 = 1190

⇒ Total score of second group = 61 × 90 = 5490

⇒ Combined total score = 1190 + 5490 = 6680

⇒ Class average = 6680 ÷ 78

⇒ Average = 85.6410...

Rounding to one decimal place, we get 85.6.

**∴ The correct answer is 85.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

It is used to find the average of groups with different sizes: Avg = (n₁w₁ + n₂w₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Assumed Mean Method

Calculation is simplified by taking a temporary average and adjusting by (Sum of deviations ÷ Total count).

Rounding Rule

To round to one decimal place, look at the second decimal digit; if it is 5 or more, round up the first decimal digit.

questions.question:
Simplify the following.

 (sqrt{6} times sqrt{15} - 5sqrt{10}) + 3sqrt{10}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

√6 × √15 = √90 = 3√10

Expression = (3√10 − 5√10) + 3√10

⇒ −2√10 + 3√10 = √10

**∴ The correct answer is √10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: (√6 × √15 − 5√10) + 3√10

Formula Used: √a × √b = √ab

⇒ (√(6 × 15) − 5√10) + 3√10

⇒ (√90 − 5√10) + 3√10

⇒ (√(9 × 10) − 5√10) + 3√10

⇒ (3√10 − 5√10) + 3√10

⇒ −2√10 + 3√10

⇒ (3 − 2)√10

⇒ √10

**∴ The correct answer is √10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule for Surds

For any positive real numbers a and b, the square root of their product is √a × √b = √ab.

Simplifying Radicals

A radical is in simplest form when the radicand has no perfect square factors other than 1, such as √90 = √(9 × 10) = 3√10.

Addition of Like Radicals

Only like radicals (radicals with the same index and same radicand) can be added or subtracted using the rule a√x ± b√x = (a ± b)√x.

questions.question: The wages of 5 carpenters for a 2-day week are ₹1,220. What are the 1-day wages (in ₹) of one carpenter?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total wages for 5 carpenters for 2 days = ₹1,220

Calculate total carpenter-days = 5 carpenters × 2 days = 10 man-days

1-day wage for 1 carpenter = Total wages ÷ Total man-days

Wage = 1220 ÷ 10 = 122

**∴ The correct answer is ₹122.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of carpenters (M₁) = 5

Number of days (D₁) = 2

Total Wages (W₁) = ₹1,220

**Formula Used:**

Wages ∝ (Number of workers × Time)

W₁ / (M₁ × D₁) = W₂ / (M₂ × D₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12351df139e5bab89fe1516bd81e0fdb221f20e23c82c083480ee951b6038ee1.png] 

⇒ Total work units = 5 × 2 = 10 units

⇒ 10 units = ₹1,220

⇒ 1 unit = 1220 ÷ 10

⇒ 1 unit = ₹122

**∴ The correct answer is ₹122.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule for Wages

When multiple variables (men, days, hours) are involved, the formula is (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) / W₂.

Work & Wages Concept

Wages are distributed in the ratio of the work done by each individual. For equal efficiency, it is proportional to the time spent.

Unitary Method

Always find the value for one unit (one person for one day) by dividing the total amount by the product of the number of people and days.

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks his goods at X% above the cost price and sells them at a discount of 48%. If he makes a profit of 82%, find the value of X.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct ratio formula between Marked Price (MP) and Cost Price (CP):

MP/CP = (100 + Profit%)/(100 − Discount%)

MP/CP = (100 + 82)/(100 − 48) = 182/52 = 3.5/1

Mark-up % (X) = (Ratio − 1) × 100

X = (3.5 − 1) × 100 = 250%

**∴ The correct answer is 250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Discount % = 48%

Profit % = 82%

**Formula Used:**

SP = CP × (100 + P%)/100

MP = SP × 100 / (100 − D%)

Mark-up % (X) = [(MP − CP) / CP] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496a7885da66cd688938534900039357eedff1cafd14da8eb0dbb19f72e5a46e.png] 

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100 units

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = CP + 82% of CP

⇒ SP = 100 + 82 = 182 units

⇒ SP = MP × (100 − Discount%)/100

⇒ 182 = MP × (100 − 48)/100

⇒ 182 = MP × 52/100

⇒ MP = (182 × 100) / 52

⇒ MP = 350 units

⇒ Mark-up = MP − CP = 350 − 100 = 250 units

⇒ X% = (Mark-up / CP) × 100

⇒ X% = (250 / 100) × 100 = 250%

**∴ The correct answer is 250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between CP and MP

The most efficient way to link mark-up, discount, and profit is: MP/CP = (100 + P%)/(100 − D%).

Successive Percentage Method

Profit % can be calculated using the net effect of mark-up (m) and discount (d): Net % = m − d − (md/100).

Mark-up Calculation

Mark-up value is always calculated on the Cost Price (CP), whereas Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP).

questions.question: The radii of two cylinders is in the ratio 3 : 4 and their heights is in the ratio 5 : 2. The ratio of their volumes will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Volumes of cylinders (V₁ : V₂) = (r₁ : r₂)² × (h₁ : h₂)

Given: r₁ : r₂ = 3 : 4 and h₁ : h₂ = 5 : 2

V₁ : V₂ = (3)² × 5 : (4)² × 2

V₁ : V₂ = (9 × 5) : (16 × 2) = 45 : 32

**∴ The correct answer is 45 : 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Ratio of radii (r₁ : r₂) = 3 : 4

Ratio of heights (h₁ : h₂) = 5 : 2

Formula used: Volume of a Cylinder (V) = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba492729790b03ec12e5ab044598ff90970d43e8b5b624bf4f0249144057947.png] 

⇒ Let the radii be 3x and 4x, and heights be 5y and 2y.

⇒ Volume of first cylinder (V₁) = π × (3x)² × 5y

⇒ V₁ = π × 9x² × 5y = 45πx²y

⇒ Volume of second cylinder (V₂) = π × (4x)² × 2y

⇒ V₂ = π × 16x² × 2y = 32πx²y

⇒ Ratio V₁ : V₂ = 45πx²y : 32πx²y

⇒ Ratio = 45 : 32

**∴ The correct answer is 45 : 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cylinder

The amount of space occupied by a cylinder is given by V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved surface only is CSA = 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the area of the curved surface and the two circular bases is TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Ratio Property for Cylinders

If radii ratio is a:b and heights ratio is c:d, then Volume ratio = (a² × c) : (b² × d) and CSA ratio = (a × c) : (b × d).

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 6 and 4 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 3, 6, and 4 = 12 units (Total Work)

Efficiencies: A = 12/3 = 4, B = 12/6 = 2, C = 12/4 = 3

Combined Efficiency (A + B + C) = 4 + 2 + 3 = 9 units/day

Thrice the work = 12 × 3 = 36 units

Time taken = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Time taken by A = 3 days, B = 6 days, C = 4 days.

Formula: Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

⇒ Total efficiency of A + B + C = 4 + 2 + 3 = 9 units/day

⇒ Standard Total Work = 12 units

⇒ New Work to be completed = 3 × 12 = 36 units

⇒ Time required = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time required = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time when work is constant. Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.

Combined Work Formula

If three people do work in x, y, and z days, the time taken together is (x × y × z) ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Pipes and Cisterns

The concept of time and work is identical to pipes filling a tank, where efficiency represents the flow rate.

questions.question: If p : q : r = 8 : 5 : 12 and r : s = 36 : 18, then what is the value of p : q : r : s?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the common term r in both ratios.

Ratio 1: p : q : r = 8 : 5 : 12

Ratio 2: r : s = 36 : 18

Equate r by multiplying Ratio 1 by 3 (since 12 × 3 = 36).

Combined Ratio = (8 × 3) : (5 × 3) : (12 × 3) : 18 = 24 : 15 : 36 : 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 24:15:36:18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

p : q : r = 8 : 5 : 12

r : s = 36 : 18

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c3e50669f2ccb9c98140c0b0901e80e53e0cd4ad1fa6f98cf90c318bb68b21c.png] 

To join the ratios, the value of the common variable (r) must be the same in both sets.

⇒ In first ratio, r = 12

⇒ In second ratio, r = 36

⇒ L.C.M. of 12 and 36 = 36

⇒ Multiply the first ratio by (36 ÷ 12) = 3

⇒ p : q : r = (8 × 3) : (5 × 3) : (12 × 3) = 24 : 15 : 36

⇒ Now, r : s = 36 : 18

⇒ Combining both: p : q : r : s = 24 : 15 : 36 : 18

**∴ The correct answer is 24:15:36:18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of two ratios a : b and c : d is calculated as (a × c) : (b × d).

Inverse Ratio

The inverse ratio of a : b is 1/a : 1/b, which simplifies to b : a.

Proportion Rule

If four quantities a, b, c, d are in proportion (a : b = c : d), then the product of extremes equals the product of means: a × d = b × c.

questions.question: Two trains, 295 m and 215 m in length are running in opposite directions. The first runs at the rate of 61 km/hr and the second at the rate of 47 km/hr. How long will they take to cross each other?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed (opposite direction) = 61 + 47 = 108 km/hr

Speed in m/s = 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

Total distance = 295 + 215 = 510 m

Time = 510 / 30 = 17 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 17 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Length of first train L₁ = 295 m, Length of second train L₂ = 215 m

Speed of first train S₁ = 61 km/hr, Speed of second train S₂ = 47 km/hr

Formula: Time taken to cross = (Total Length) ÷ (Relative Speed)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e05aa9213f36d55ea4952812ddc966b1a8ea7729c677caa4e22830cc35010f64.png] ⇒ Total distance to be covered = 295 + 215 = 510 m ⇒ Relative speed in opposite direction = S₁ + S₂ ⇒ Relative speed = 61 + 47 = 108 km/hr ⇒ Converting speed to m/s = 108 × (5/18) = 6 × 5 = 30 m/s ⇒ Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed ⇒ Time = 510 ÷ 30 = 17 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 17 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Direction

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ + S₂.

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = |S₁ − S₂|.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Train passing stationary objects

When a train passes a pole or a person, the distance covered is its own length. When it passes a platform, the distance is (Train length + Platform length).

questions.question: Two outlet pipes, A and B, can separately empty a full tank in 17 hours and 15 hours, respectively. Both the outlet pipes are opened together for ‘x’ hours. Had outlet pipe B been opened alone, it would have taken (x + 5) hours to empty the same quantity of water from the tank. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Work done by (A + B) in x hours = Work done by B in (x + 5) hours.

⇒ (EfficiencyA + EfficiencyB) × x = EfficiencyB × (x + 5)

⇒ 15x + 17x = 17x + 85 (Using Efficiency A=15, B=17 from inverse of time)

⇒ 15x = 85 ⇒ x = 85/15 = 17/3 = 5 2/3 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 2/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A = 17 hours

Time taken by Pipe B = 15 hours

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of individual times; Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Combined efficiency of A + B = 15 + 17 = 32 units/hr

⇒ Quantity emptied by (A + B) in x hours = 32 × x = 32x units

⇒ Quantity emptied by B alone in (x + 5) hours = 17 × (x + 5) units

⇒ Since the quantity is the same: 32x = 17(x + 5)

⇒ 32x = 17x + 85

⇒ 32x − 17x = 85

⇒ 15x = 85

⇒ x = 85 ÷ 15 = 17 ÷ 3

⇒ x = 5 2/3 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 5 2/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

Outlet pipes are considered to do negative work. If an outlet pipe empties a tank in T hours, its efficiency is −1/T per hour.

Efficiency and Time Relationship

The efficiency of a pipe is inversely proportional to the time it takes to fill or empty the tank (Efficiency ∝ 1/Time).

Combined Work Equation

When multiple pipes work together, the total efficiency is the algebraic sum of their individual efficiencies (Net E = E₁ + E₂ + ...).
